html:
Discover the beauty of Ninh Binh through ancient history, peaceful rivers, limestone mountains, and countryside cycling. This tour is perfect for travelers looking for a relaxing yet enriching cultural experience outside Hanoi.

Itinerary

07:00 – 07:45 – Pick-up from Your Hotel

Your tour guide will meet you at your hotel or accommodation in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Begin the 110–kilometer journey through the lush countryside on a modern, comfortable bus. A short break will be made along the way.

10:00 – Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Explore Vietnam’s former capital and visit the Dinh King Temple and Le King Temple, both dating back to the seventeenth century. Learn about the early dynasties of Vietnam and admire the ancient architectural styles preserved here.

12:00 – Lunch at a Local Restaurant

Enjoy a delicious Vietnamese buffet lunch at The Long Restaurant, which offers a beautiful panoramic view of the Tam Coc area.

13:30 – Sampan Boat Trip in Tam Coc

Board a traditional sampan boat for a 1.5-hour journey through Tam Coc, meaning “Three Caves.”

Admire the majestic limestone mountains, peaceful rivers, rice paddies, and serene countryside scenery. The journey offers fantastic opportunities for photography and moments of complete relaxation.

15:30 – Countryside Cycling

Enjoy a leisurely cycling tour along rural paths, canal networks, and charming small villages, surrounded by the impressive limestone mountain landscape.

16:00 – Return to Hanoi

Board the bus for your journey back to Hanoi.

18:00 – 18:30 – Arrival in Hanoi

You will be dropped off at your hotel or accommodation. The tour concludes.

Inclusion

  • Pick-up from hotel or accommodation in Hanoi Old Quarter by Bus or Limousine Bus

  • Fully escorted tour with a professional English-speaking guide

  • Two bottles of water per person

  • Buffet lunch at The Long Restaurant with a panoramic view of Tam Coc

  • All entrance fees listed in the itinerary

Exclusion

  • Beverages, travel insurance, personal expenses, and tips for the guide

  • Limousine bus upgrade (19 seats) additional 5 United States Dollars per person

  • Children from 5 to 8 years old: 75 percent of adult price

  • Children from 9 years old and above: charged as adults

  • Children under 5 years old: free of charge (excluding entrance tickets, meals, and bus seat)

Tour Price

26 United States Dollars per person
